name: BXGY discount settings
description: Configure Buy X Get Y like native Shopify BOGO (free reward with minimum line price)
title: Buy X get Y

displayName.label: Name shown in cart and checkout
displayName.help: Use the same value as the discount title above (for example Bogo25). Automatic discounts show this name on the cart and checkout.
displayName.error: Specify a name to show customers in cart and checkout.

customerBuys.heading: Customer buys
customerBuys.quantityHelp: Minimum quantity of items the customer must buy. Extra buy items beyond completed sets stay full price.
customerBuys.quantityError: Specify a quantity of products the customer must buy.
customerBuys.productsError: Specify a product the customer must buy.
customerBuys.collectionsError: Specify a collection the customer must buy.

customerGets.heading: Customer gets
customerGets.help: Customers must add the quantity of items specified below to their cart.
customerGets.quantityHelp: Reward items discounted per completed buy set. Extra get items stay full price.
customerGets.quantityError: Specify a quantity of products the customer will get.
customerGets.productsError: Specify a product the customer will get.
customerGets.collectionsError: Specify a collection the customer will get.

discountValue.heading: At a discounted value
discountValue.freeHelp: Reward items are treated as free in the order total using the minimum line price split.

maxUses.label: Set a maximum number of uses per order
maxUses.help: Optional. Leave unchecked for unlimited stacking like native Buy X Get Y (Buy 2 with qty 4 = 2 sets).

floorPrice.label: Minimum line price
floorPrice.help: Reward lines are charged this amount; the same amount is discounted from a buy line (default 0.50).

validation.bannerOne: There is 1 error with this discount:

error: Unable to save discount settings. Ensure the discount uses the Product discount class and try again.
